author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices a beat in three, finding a special note, echoing short patterns and taking turns, with a gentle song about a lost puppy.

classes.title: Waltz with the puppy
classes.goal: Feel this song's swing in three by rocking together: one, two, three.

mathTarget.parentLine: This song moves in threes: one, two, three

classes.parentPrompt: Hold your child and rock with a bigger lean on 'one': one, two, three.
classes.childAction: Rock with your grown-up and lean on 'one'.
classes.bridge: The beat is a puppy wagging its tail: wag, two, three, wag, two, three.

intro.caption: This song goes one, two, three

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: feeling a beat that moves in threes.

classes.title: One, two, three, wag
classes.goal: Tap the beat and make 'one' the strong tap in each group of three.

mathTarget.parentLine: Counting one, two, three, and starting again

classes.parentPrompt: Count 'one, two, three' aloud and tap your child's hand firmly on 'one'.
classes.childAction: Tap any key: big tap on one, small taps on two, three.
classes.bridge: One is a big paw step; two and three are little tiptoes.

intro.caption: Big one, little two, three
intro.parentCue: count aloud and tap their hand on 'one'

games.caption: Where can he be?
games.parentCue: Count 'one, two, three' slowly with the taps

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: counting and tapping in groups of three.

classes.title: Find the puppy's note E
classes.goal: Find E by touch: it sits just right of the two black keys.

mathTarget.parentLine: Using the two black keys to find one white key

classes.parentPrompt: Guide your child's finger to the two black keys, then slide right onto E.
classes.childAction: Touch the two black keys, slide right, and press E gently.
classes.bridge: The two black keys are a doghouse; E sits right outside the door.

intro.caption: Find the two black keys
intro.parentCue: let your child touch them first, then find E

games.caption: E, E, E: one, two, three

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: finding one key by its landmark.

classes.title: Look up the steps
classes.goal: Listen to a short 2 or 3 note call, then play it back the same.

mathTarget.parentLine: Holding a short pattern in mind, then repeating it

classes.parentPrompt: Play or sing the call first, then point to your child: your turn.
classes.childAction: Listen to the call, then play it back the same way.
classes.bridge: C, D, E climbs three steps, peeking for the puppy upstairs.

intro.caption: I call, you call back
intro.parentCue: listen together first, then let your child copy

games.caption: Up three steps: C, D, E
games.parentCue: Walk your fingers up your child's arm

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: listening, remembering and copying short patterns.

classes.title: Asking and answering
classes.goal: Hear that some lines ask a question and the last one comes home.

mathTarget.parentLine: Some tunes sound unfinished; one sounds like home

classes.parentPrompt: Shrug and look around on 'where?'; rest your hands in your lap when the tune lands home.
classes.childAction: Copy the asking notes, then the home notes, and feel the difference.
classes.bridge: Stopping on D sounds like 'where?'; landing on C sounds like 'home'.

intro.caption: Does it ask, or is it home?
intro.parentCue: shrug for asking, hands in lap for home

games.caption: Asking: E, D?
games.parentCue: Shrug your shoulders on the D

games.caption: Home: D, C.
games.parentCue: Rest your hands in your lap on C

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing asking and answering in a tune.

classes.title: Wait for the E
classes.goal: Wait while the grown-up plays, then play E when it is your turn.

mathTarget.parentLine: Waiting for your part, then joining in

classes.parentPrompt: Play your part, then nod to your child just before each E; smile while they wait.
classes.childAction: Wait for the nod, then press E.
classes.bridge: The puppy hides and waits; when you hear its spot, press E.

intro.caption: Wait, wait... now E!
intro.parentCue: nod to your child when it is their turn

games.caption: Find your E
games.parentCue: Point to the key, then let them press

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: waiting for a turn, then joining in.

classes.title: E or D? Pick one
classes.goal: Play two special notes, E and D, choosing the right one by listening.

mathTarget.parentLine: Sorting each sound into one of two boxes

classes.parentPrompt: Point to D or E before each turn at first, then let your child choose.
classes.childAction: Listen, choose D or E, and press the right one.
classes.bridge: D sits inside the doghouse, between the black keys; E sits by the door.

intro.caption: Inside D, or door E?
intro.parentCue: point first, then let your child choose alone

games.caption: Find E, then D
games.parentCue: Point to each key, say its name

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: telling two sounds apart and choosing one.

classes.title: Waltz together
classes.goal: Play the whole song together, sharing one beat in three.

mathTarget.parentLine: Two players keep one beat together

classes.parentPrompt: Play the tune and nod on each 'one'; keep going if your child misses.
classes.childAction: Play your notes and nod along with your grown-up.
classes.bridge: Two friends looking for the puppy walk together: one, two, three.

intro.caption: Two players, one waltz
intro.parentCue: nod on 'one' so your child can see it

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing one song together, one beat.

classes.title: Puppy concert for teddy
classes.goal: Play the whole song for teddy, end on the home note and bow.

mathTarget.parentLine: The tune ends by landing on its home note

classes.parentPrompt: Sit teddy as the audience; hold the last note together, then clap and bow.
classes.childAction: Play for teddy, hold the last note, then take a bow.
classes.bridge: The tune wanders and asks 'where?', then lands softly home on C.

intro.caption: Concert time for teddy!
intro.parentCue: put teddy in front as the audience

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a whole song, start to end.
